items.title: 2.2.1.2 Variable Naming Rules in Python (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of naming rules (PDF 36).

items: Naam harf (a-z, A-Z) ya underscore (_) se shuru hona chahiye.
Baad ke characters harf, adad (0-9) ya underscore ho sakte hain.
Naam chhote bare harf mein farq karte hain: age aur Age do alag variables hain.
Python ke mahfooz alfaaz (keywords), jaise for, while aur if, variable ke naam nahi ban sakte.

blocks.text: Hamesha ba-maani naam rakhein (a ki bajaye age). Achi aadat hai ke chhote harf aur alfaaz ke darmiyan underscore istemal karein, jaise student_name; is andaaz ko snake_case kehte hain. Python mein strings hamesha quotes mein hoti hain, single (' ') ya double (" ").

blocks.prompt: In mein se kaunsa durust variable naam hai: variable1, 1variable, variable-name, variable name (MCQ 3)?
blocks.explanation: variable1, option (a); baqi adad se shuru hote ya hyphen ya space rakhte hain.

items: Qawaid: harf ya _ se shuru, phir harf, adad, _; chhote bare harf mein farq; keywords nahi; ba-maani snake_case naam.
